'''Reinforced battle belts''' were an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were metallic [[Silver/Legends|silver]] in color with a single [[Red (disambiguation)|red]] button.
